claim: The four goal write routes in apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/analytics.controller.ts -- POST goals/:restaurantId (create), PATCH goals/:restaurantId/:goalId (edit), PUT goals/:restaurantId/:goalId/status and POST goals/:restaurantId/:goalId/cutting-spec (Ask the book, which calls the paid model) -- each carry @UseGuards(RolesGuard) and @Roles("owner", "manager") between their route decorator and their handler, behind the class-level JwtAuthGuard (ADR 0250, founder 2026-10-01). RolesGuard reads req.user.role, which JwtStrategy sets from the caller's active user_restaurant_access row in the token's house and never from users.role. The three goal reads and POST goal-scenarios/requests/:restaurantId carry no @Roles and no RolesGuard. createGoal passes the body through with createdBy set AFTER the spread, from @CurrentUser() user.userId, so a body createdBy is overwritten. route-access.expected.json records the four writes as [owner, manager] and the four others as open. The behavioural proof is goal-writes-need-a-manager.spec.ts (real JwtAuthGuard, JwtStrategy and AuthService.validateJwtPayload; staff and a null-role row get 403 with body message 'Forbidden resource' and nothing reaches GoalsService; created_by is the caller); this verify is static text matching over the controller, the expected table and the spec's titles, and does not run the spec.

claim: On /recommendations, 'Make this a goal' (Entry.tsx) and the margin's 'Set a goal ->' (GoalsMargin.tsx) are drawn as disabled rc-dark buttons whose title is a reason, for anyone the data hook does not read as owner or manager (ADR 0250, founder 2026-10-01: 'Disabled with a reason'); the goal sheet opens only when mayOpenGoal holds. The reason comes from goalRoleReasonFor(activeRole) in useRecommendationsNextData.ts -- activeRole alone, never the user.role fallback the shell uses -- and is 'Goals are set by owners and managers.' for staff and a not-confirmed, not-offered sentence for null or any other role. A goal write the gateway refuses with 403 'Forbidden resource' is said as GOAL_WRITE_ROLE_REFUSED (exported with goalWriteRoleRefusal from apps/web/src/pages/reports/next/useGoalsDesk.ts and used by the desk's run and ask paths and by the recommendations createGoal); any other 403 keeps its own message. The verify is static text matching over the five source files and two test files; it pins the titles of the [REVERT-FAILS] tests for the disabled door, the activeRole-only reason and the 403 words (that test also asserts the note never contains 'Forbidden resource'), and that Entry's goalRoleReason and GoalsMargin's roleReason are required props typed string | null. It does not render the page or run the tests (RecommendationsNext.test.tsx and useRecommendationsNextData.test.tsx do).
